purpose: Required inputs for a variant-resolved horizontal Porsche 935 cooling system; no physical values admitted
scope: Published input requirements and evidence pointers; new engine research bundle pending

levels.name: Identity, geometry inventory and digital evidence
levels.scope: Inspectable geometry/frames/claims. No physical airflow or operating qualification.

levels.name: First isolated cold-flow fan model
levels.scope: Prescribed signed fan speed, admitted or explicit hypothetical rotor/shroud/clearances, air states and pressure/backpressure; accepted numerical QA. No internal engine CAD required.

levels.name: Installed cold-flow network and drive/mechanical model
levels.scope: Variant-resolved engine-to-fan relation, drive/supports/lubrication/load paths, installation/branch resistance, torque/power and material/dynamics.

levels.name: Coupled engine cooling
levels.scope: Component heat sources, fin/solid/contact or calibrated reduced models, oil and applicable turbo/intercooler/coolant networks, thermal properties and validation.

levels.name: Mission/state-correlated physical twin
levels.scope: Transient operating/thermal/mechanical states, independent correlation and validity envelope.

levels.name: Manufacturing route definition
levels.scope: Parallel lane; cannot substitute for physical-model evidence.

levels.name: Actual-build release
levels.scope: Professional review and approved physical validation plan; default blocked.

rows.quantity: Named variant, engine revision and assembly/build identity
rows.first_model_role: mandatory for physically interpretable first cold-flow model; assumption only for an explicitly hypothetical model
rows.conditions_and_definition: Use project specimen/build aliases and engine/assembly revision; keep private serial/vehicle identifiers outside the package.
rows.required_evidence: Variant-specific primary documentation plus specimen/assembly identification.
rows.gap: No named specimen/variant admitted for the scan.

rows.quantity: Scan/export scale and independent dimensional calibration
rows.first_model_role: mandatory for physically interpretable first cold-flow model; assumption only for an explicitly hypothetical model
rows.conditions_and_definition: Export units and at least two independently measured dimensions, instrument uncertainty and temperature; do not use a catalogue diameter to scale the scan.
rows.required_evidence: Export metadata and traceable outside-diameter/bore metrology.
rows.gap: OBJ scale unknown; filename is not calibration.

rows.quantity: Raw geometry provenance, derivative rights and reconstruction history
rows.first_model_role: raw provenance/use scope required; redistribution permission required only if publishing restricted derivatives
rows.conditions_and_definition: Immutable raw digest; acquisition passes, transforms, repair/deviation history and scope of permitted reuse.
rows.required_evidence: Rights statement plus traceable reconstruction and immutable raw intake.
rows.gap: Private acquisition known; derivative publication rights and pass alignment unresolved.

rows.quantity: Horizontal arrangement, datum frame, rotation axis and gravity
rows.first_model_role: mandatory for physically interpretable first cold-flow model; assumption only for an explicitly hypothetical model
rows.conditions_and_definition: Define whether horizontal means disk plane or shaft. Declare vehicle/engine frame, fan axis, inlet/outlet normals, world transform and gravity; do not inherit +Z from an old USD asset.
rows.required_evidence: Measured assembly datums and dimensioned coordinate convention.
rows.gap: Physical horizontal mounting/frame not admitted.

rows.quantity: Editable rotor geometry and topology
rows.first_model_role: mandatory for physically interpretable first cold-flow model; assumption only for an explicitly hypothetical model
rows.conditions_and_definition: Blade count/handedness, section/pitch/camber/thickness/root/hub geometry and intentional openings; deviations and uncertainty.
rows.required_evidence: Measured reconstructed source plus independent closedness/intersection/topology/deviation checks.
rows.gap: Open two-component scan and unqualified existing hypotheses are not a functional 935 reference.

rows.quantity: Shroud, inlet, support/stator geometry and cold gaps
rows.first_model_role: mandatory for physically interpretable first cold-flow model; assumption only for an explicitly hypothetical model
rows.conditions_and_definition: Minimum tip and axial clearances at stated assembly temperature; shroud/cone/stators/obstructions and leakage paths. Geometry of external stationary components can matter even when their internals do not.
rows.required_evidence: Variant-matched CAD/metrology, runout and tolerance stack.
rows.gap: No admitted 935 housing or gap stack.

rows.quantity: Functional shaft/hub/bearing/drive interfaces and load path
rows.first_model_role: defer from isolated cold-flow model; needed at this later fidelity level
rows.conditions_and_definition: Seats, bores, mounting faces, threads/key/spline/bolt interfaces, stack, preload and radial/axial load paths.
rows.required_evidence: Dimensioned measured interfaces and independent assembly contract.
rows.gap: Measured horizontal drive interfaces absent.

rows.quantity: Operating minimum gaps and expansion envelope
rows.first_model_role: defer from isolated cold-flow model; needed at this later fidelity level
rows.conditions_and_definition: Combine tolerances, thermal and centrifugal growth, bearing deflection and runout without double-counting uncertainty.
rows.required_evidence: Correlated temperature/deformation/support model and operating metrology.
rows.gap: No qualified hot/rotating clearance envelope.

rows.quantity: Signed fan speed and aerodynamic speed envelope
rows.first_model_role: mandatory for physically interpretable first cold-flow model; assumption only for an explicitly hypothetical model
rows.conditions_and_definition: Continuous points, sweep endpoints, acceleration and overshoot; store rpm and convert explicitly. Prescribed exploratory rpm is not an approved operating limit.
rows.required_evidence: Synchronized fan tachometry or variant-specific drive relation.
rows.gap: No measured 935 fan-speed envelope.

rows.quantity: Rotation direction, blade handedness and observation view
rows.first_model_role: mandatory for physically interpretable first cold-flow model; assumption only for an explicitly hypothetical model
rows.conditions_and_definition: State CW/CCW together with observer position/view direction and signed fan axis. Check intended flow direction independently; photographs without a view convention are insufficient.
rows.required_evidence: Primary assembly direction specification or witnessed rotation with frame.
rows.gap: View/sign/handedness of target assembly unresolved.

rows.quantity: Inlet total pressure, total temperature and air composition
rows.first_model_role: mandatory for physically interpretable first cold-flow model; assumption only for an explicitly hypothetical model
rows.conditions_and_definition: Distinguish inlet air from ambient and charge air; identify stations, pressure type, recirculation, humidity/composition and uncertainty.
rows.required_evidence: Calibrated station measurements at specified operating points.
rows.gap: No named inlet state or station measurements.

rows.quantity: Inlet turbulence, swirl and spatial profiles
rows.first_model_role: mandatory for physically interpretable first cold-flow model; assumption only for an explicitly hypothetical model
rows.conditions_and_definition: Velocity/swirl profile, turbulence intensity and length scale or model-consistent quantities; alternatives are labeled sensitivities.
rows.required_evidence: Traverse/measurement or admitted upstream representation.
rows.gap: No inlet profile; any uniform profile is an assumption.

rows.quantity: Outlet static pressure/backpressure and pressure stations
rows.canonical_units: Pa absolute or Pa gauge with reference
rows.first_model_role: mandatory for physically interpretable first cold-flow model; assumption only for an explicitly hypothetical model
rows.conditions_and_definition: Specify outlet station and reference, fan pressure-rise definition, static/total quantities and pressure-sweep points. Do not prescribe both flow and pressure as independent constraints unless physically justified.
rows.required_evidence: Calibrated fan bench boundary conditions or matched resistance network.
rows.gap: No target outlet/installed backpressure.

rows.quantity: Air density, viscosity, heat capacity, conductivity and compressibility basis
rows.first_model_role: mandatory for physically interpretable first cold-flow model; assumption only for an explicitly hypothetical model
rows.conditions_and_definition: Property functions at the admitted pressure/temperature/composition; assess Mach and compressibility from the actual operating/geometry conditions.
rows.required_evidence: Referenced property model plus regime assessment.
rows.gap: No admitted target state/property basis.

rows.quantity: Installed air inlet/outlet paths, sealing and recirculation
rows.first_model_role: defer from isolated cold-flow model; needed at this later fidelity level
rows.conditions_and_definition: Vehicle speed, external pressure zones, grilles/bodywork, engine-bay inlet, outlet routing, sealing/leakage and obstructions.
rows.required_evidence: Variant-matched assembly CAD and pressure/flow measurements.
rows.gap: No identified installed horizontal air circuit.

rows.quantity: Cooling branch resistance and flow split
rows.first_model_role: defer from isolated cold-flow model; needed at this later fidelity level
rows.conditions_and_definition: Each named head/cylinder/auxiliary branch, leakage branch and cooler path; specify whether losses use pressure or pressure-squared laws and calibration domain.
rows.required_evidence: Measured loss curves or validated porous/network model.
rows.gap: No per-branch resistance map.

rows.quantity: Fan performance validation map
rows.canonical_units: kg/s or m^3/s with density; Pa; N*m; W
rows.first_model_role: defer from isolated cold-flow model; needed at this later fidelity level
rows.conditions_and_definition: Matched signed speeds, pressure stations, inlet states, fixture corrections, flow-pressure-torque/power map and uncertainty.
rows.required_evidence: Instrumented fan bench points/curve with calibration.
rows.gap: No correlated horizontal 935 fan bench map.

rows.quantity: Unsteady interactions and pressure/acoustic validation
rows.first_model_role: defer from isolated cold-flow model; needed at this later fidelity level
rows.conditions_and_definition: Rotor-stator/drive interactions, blade passage and engine-order forcing; phase/sampling/time-step and observation locations.
rows.required_evidence: Time-synchronized pressure/vibration data and transient refinement.
rows.gap: No target unsteady pressure or phase-resolved data.

rows.quantity: Numerical geometry/mesh and convergence contract
rows.first_model_role: mandatory for physically interpretable first cold-flow model; assumption only for an explicitly hypothetical model
rows.conditions_and_definition: Independent geometry retention, standard/extended mesh QA, conservation, iteration/mesh/wall/turbulence sensitivity; criteria declared before the solve.
rows.required_evidence: Versioned native QA and independent convergence evidence.
rows.gap: Existing E-R1 meshes rejected; no accepted horizontal 935 mesh.

rows.quantity: Engine speed, engine loading and drive state
rows.first_model_role: may be replaced by directly prescribed fan speed for isolated flow; required for engine-linked results
rows.conditions_and_definition: Idle/part/full load, limiter/overrun/start/stop and time history at named configuration. Engine brake power is not fan shaft power or heat rejection.
rows.required_evidence: Variant-specific engine dyno/operating data with conditions.
rows.gap: No admitted engine operating map or speed-time traces.

rows.quantity: Engine-to-fan speed ratio and drive topology
rows.first_model_role: may be replaced by directly prescribed fan speed for isolated flow; required for engine-linked results
rows.conditions_and_definition: Define r=|n_fan|/|n_engine|, every drive stage and direction, possible clutch/slip/speed dependence. Fan, alternator and pump ratios stay separate.
rows.required_evidence: Synchronized engine/fan tachometry plus verified gears/pulley/drive documentation.
rows.gap: No confirmed horizontal drive ratio; no borrowed 993 ratio.

rows.quantity: Fan shaft torque, absorbed mechanical power and losses
rows.first_model_role: defer from isolated cold-flow model; needed at this later fidelity level
rows.conditions_and_definition: Torque sign/on-rotor convention, power-versus-speed/flow; distinguish aerodynamic torque, bearing/gearing/seal losses and auxiliary loads.
rows.required_evidence: Torque measurement/dyno and documented loss decomposition.
rows.gap: No drive-efficiency/loss or shaft-power map.

rows.quantity: Gear/belt/shaft drive definition and transmitted loads
rows.first_model_role: defer from isolated cold-flow model; needed at this later fidelity level
rows.conditions_and_definition: Actual installed drive stages, tooth/belt/contact geometry, materials, alignments, pretension/backlash, housing stiffness and gear/bearing load paths. Do not assume a belt or gear layout from a different variant.
rows.required_evidence: Variant-specific measured drawings, ratings and drive analysis.
rows.gap: Horizontal drive geometry and loads unverified.

rows.quantity: Rotor material, density and elastic/strength/fatigue state
rows.first_model_role: defer from isolated cold-flow model; needed at this later fidelity level
rows.conditions_and_definition: Actual alloy/condition/process/orientation/surface; E(T), nu(T), density, strengths and fatigue/statistical basis. Hypothetical cards permit screening only.
rows.required_evidence: Material identification and condition-matched properties/coupons.
rows.gap: Legacy assumed material is not an admitted 935 material.

rows.quantity: Bearing, support/contact and assembly preload
rows.canonical_units: m; N/m; N*s/m; N*m/rad; N*m*s/rad; N; K
rows.first_model_role: defer from isolated cold-flow model; needed at this later fidelity level
rows.conditions_and_definition: Exact bearing type/seats/internal clearance, radial/axial/tilt stiffness/damping versus load/speed/temperature; contact/preload and mounting compliance.
rows.required_evidence: Bearing/assembly specification, fits and support characterization.
rows.gap: Fixed-bore hypothesis is not realistic 935 support evidence.

rows.quantity: Prestressed rotating dynamics, forcing and balance
rows.first_model_role: defer from isolated cold-flow model; needed at this later fidelity level
rows.conditions_and_definition: Mode tracking, gyroscopic/centrifugal/thermal prestress, imbalance, engine/gear/blade orders, acceleration, damping and bearing critical speeds.
rows.required_evidence: Identified modes and speed/vibration/phase measurements.
rows.gap: No correlated horizontal drive dynamics or validated Campbell map.

rows.quantity: Bearing/gearing oil or other lubrication circuit
rows.first_model_role: defer from isolated cold-flow model; needed at this later fidelity level
rows.conditions_and_definition: First establish lubrication architecture. If oil-fed: grade/viscosity(T), supply/return, pressure/flow, seals, oil temperature and friction heat; if not applicable record supported N/A.
rows.required_evidence: Variant-specific bearing/drive lubrication specification and measurements.
rows.gap: Drive/bearing lubrication path unresolved; neither dry nor engine-oil-fed assumed.
rows.applicability_condition: Architecture evidence determines whether oil, grease or another route applies.

rows.quantity: Mechanical duty, endurance and overspeed validation
rows.first_model_role: defer from isolated cold-flow model; needed at this later fidelity level
rows.conditions_and_definition: Lifetime, starts/stops, transient speed/load, thermal cycles, balancing/runout inspection and guarded test plan.
rows.required_evidence: Approved engineering validation plan and instrumented tests.
rows.gap: No qualified operating limit or fatigue lifetime.

rows.quantity: Variant-specific cooling architecture and circuit routing
rows.first_model_role: defer from isolated cold-flow model; needed at this later fidelity level
rows.conditions_and_definition: Identify head/cylinder/oil cooling, any coolant circuit, turbo/intercooler paths and shared/independent air circuits for the exact engine revision.
rows.required_evidence: Variant-specific primary circuit/assembly documentation; no automatic transfer from 935/78 to K3/K4.
rows.gap: No cooling architecture admitted across the separated variants.

rows.quantity: Ambient, inlet heating and external duty conditions
rows.first_model_role: defer from isolated cold-flow model; needed at this later fidelity level
rows.conditions_and_definition: Ambient and actual fan-inlet temperature, altitude/pressure, vehicle speed, bodywork state, soak, idle/race/endurance and start/stop timeline.
rows.required_evidence: Instrumented installation and declared environmental mission.
rows.gap: No boundary-condition/duty envelope tied to a specimen.

rows.quantity: Cylinder and head heat-rejection maps
rows.first_model_role: defer from isolated cold-flow model; needed at this later fidelity level
rows.conditions_and_definition: Spatial or lumped heat inputs versus speed/load/mixture/boost/ignition and time; partition to fins, oil, exhaust and other paths. State averaging domain.
rows.required_evidence: Measured heat balances or validated calibrated engine/thermal model.
rows.gap: No admitted component heat loads; horsepower alone cannot set them.

rows.quantity: Cooling-fin/solid geometry and contact conductance
rows.first_model_role: defer from isolated cold-flow model; needed at this later fidelity level
rows.conditions_and_definition: Fin area/thickness/spacing, conduction path and head-cylinder/crankcase/insert contacts as needed; reduced-order area/resistance models are admissible only with calibration.
rows.required_evidence: Geometry/metrology and contact/resistance calibration.
rows.gap: No measured horizontal-system solids/fin/contact dataset.

rows.quantity: Thermal material functions and temperature limits
rows.first_model_role: defer from isolated cold-flow model; needed at this later fidelity level
rows.conditions_and_definition: Actual head/cylinder/shroud/rotor material state, k(T), cp(T), CTE(T), density and justified component limits; do not borrow unrelated LPBF coupon limits.
rows.required_evidence: Material characterization and independently approved temperature constraints.
rows.gap: No condition-matched thermal cards or limits.

rows.quantity: Engine oil cooling heat load, flow and cooler routing
rows.first_model_role: defer from isolated cold-flow model; needed at this later fidelity level
rows.conditions_and_definition: Oil supply/return temperatures and flow, cooler UA or resolved geometry, thermostats/bypass, pressure drop and air-side route; separate from bearing/drive lubrication where applicable.
rows.required_evidence: Oil-circuit schematic plus instrumented oil/air heat balance.
rows.gap: Oil circuit routing and calibrated heat rejection unknown.

rows.quantity: Turbocharger heat and flow boundary data
rows.first_model_role: defer from isolated cold-flow model; needed at this later fidelity level
rows.conditions_and_definition: Turbo count/types and locations only when evidenced; exhaust/turbine/compressor states, oil/water connections if applicable, hot surfaces and heat leakage to the fan inlet/engine bay.
rows.required_evidence: Variant-matched component maps and measured operating conditions.
rows.gap: No variant-specific turbo thermal/installation card.

rows.quantity: Intercooler/charge-air system and shared cooling paths
rows.first_model_role: defer from isolated cold-flow model; needed at this later fidelity level
rows.conditions_and_definition: Charge-air flow/pressure/temperature and heat rejection; air/liquid routing, effectiveness/UA, pressure loss, packaging and whether it shares fan air. Cooling air is not charge air.
rows.required_evidence: Matched circuit diagram, calibrated exchanger/maps and installation data.
rows.gap: No admitted intercooler architecture or interface to fan air.

rows.quantity: Conditional liquid-cooled head/cylinder branch
rows.first_model_role: defer from isolated cold-flow model; needed at this later fidelity level
rows.conditions_and_definition: Add coolant composition, pump curve/ratio, jackets, heat load, radiator/air circuit and thermostat state only for an evidenced engine architecture.
rows.required_evidence: Exact-variant primary documentation and thermal measurements; never populate K3 from a 935/78 claim.
rows.gap: Applicability unresolved; absence of data is not proof of absence of coolant.
rows.applicability_condition: Only applicable when a complete accepted variant-specific claim establishes a coolant branch.

rows.quantity: Correlated solid/fluid temperature and heat-balance observations
rows.first_model_role: defer from isolated cold-flow model; needed at this later fidelity level
rows.conditions_and_definition: Head/cylinder/oil/drive temperatures, sensor position/calibration and fan air mass/enthalpy rise, losses and measurement uncertainty at matched points.
rows.required_evidence: Calibrated thermocouples/heat-flow/flow/pressure measurements.
rows.gap: No matched cooling validation dataset.

rows.quantity: Transient thermal state and mission coupling
rows.first_model_role: defer from isolated cold-flow model; needed at this later fidelity level
rows.conditions_and_definition: Initial temperatures, thermal masses, engine speed/load/environment sequence, oil/coolant control states, heat soak and time synchronization.
rows.required_evidence: Synchronized mission logs and independent transient correlation.
rows.gap: No time-resolved operating/thermal state dataset.

rows.quantity: Engine performance/fuel/exhaust boundary maps when heat loads are predicted
rows.canonical_units: rpm; N*m; W; kg/s; 1; Pa; K
rows.first_model_role: defer from isolated cold-flow model; needed at this later fidelity level
rows.conditions_and_definition: Fuel energy/flow, efficiency, mixture, boost/ignition, exhaust enthalpy and losses if deriving rejected heat. Measured component heat-load maps can replace a resolved combustion model.
rows.required_evidence: Conditioned dyno/energy balance and calibrated model; explicit uncertainty.
rows.gap: No engine heat-source model admitted; complete combustion/internal-engine CAD not mandatory when measured boundary maps suffice.

rows.quantity: Intended original replacement/redesign and selected material route
rows.first_model_role: parallel manufacturing requirement; not a prerequisite for an isolated flow calculation
rows.conditions_and_definition: Distinguish baseline original material from a new AM candidate; alloy/state/route, intended interfaces and engineering approval scope.
rows.required_evidence: Design intent and material/process admission.
rows.gap: No selected qualified horizontal impeller AM route.

rows.quantity: Machine/build envelope, powder and controlled scan/layer recipe
rows.canonical_units: m; W; m/s; s; kg; identifier
rows.first_model_role: parallel manufacturing requirement; not a prerequisite for an isolated flow calculation
rows.conditions_and_definition: Exact machine/software, usable envelope including plate, powder lot/reuse/PSD, layer/scan parameters and build thermal/gas conditions; record recipe version and rights.
rows.required_evidence: Qualified supplier/process control cards and powder records.
rows.gap: Research machine/material scenarios do not define an approved build.

rows.quantity: Build orientation, supports, plate and release sequence
rows.first_model_role: parallel manufacturing requirement; not a prerequisite for an isolated flow calculation
rows.conditions_and_definition: Orientation relative to machine axes, actual support/plate geometry/contact, allowances, drainage, release and machining datum sequence.
rows.required_evidence: Supplier-approved editable build setup and process sequence.
rows.gap: No target support/contact/release plan.

rows.quantity: Calibrated thermal/process or inherent-strain model
rows.first_model_role: parallel manufacturing requirement; not a prerequisite for an isolated flow calculation
rows.conditions_and_definition: Temperature-dependent elastic-plastic/thermal/phase data, absorption/heat loss/contact or recipe-calibrated eigenstrain; independent validation against distortion/residual stress.
rows.required_evidence: Matched calibration coupons, independent holdout builds and native solver verification.
rows.gap: Existing elastic support-release sensitivities uncalibrated; singular support peaks are not production stress predictions.

rows.quantity: Postprocessing, machining, balance and inspection acceptance
rows.first_model_role: parallel manufacturing requirement; not a prerequisite for an isolated flow calculation
rows.conditions_and_definition: Alloy-specific treatment/HIP when justified, finish/surface, bore/key/seat machining, dimensional/CT/FPI acceptance, balance and nondestructive/fatigue defect basis.
rows.required_evidence: Qualified route with capability, inspection and coupon evidence.
rows.gap: No accepted postprocessing/inspection/balance plan.

rows.quantity: Qualified structural/endurance and guarded spin/engine-test release
rows.first_model_role: parallel manufacturing requirement; not a prerequisite for an isolated flow calculation
rows.conditions_and_definition: Approval belongs to the named actual build and operating envelope; simulation/software checks alone do not authorize manufacture/installation.
rows.required_evidence: Independent engineering review and instrumented physical validation.
rows.gap: No professional approved release/validation plan for this target.

rows.quantity: Variant-resolved source admission and uncertainty ledger
rows.first_model_role: mandatory for physically interpretable first cold-flow model; assumption only for an explicitly hypothetical model
rows.conditions_and_definition: Claim-level locator/quotation or transcription, original units, conversion, conditions, conflicts, specimen applicability, uncertainty and accepted scope; admit complete research bundles only.
rows.required_evidence: Complete bundle, source-level audit and explicit per-claim admission.
rows.gap: New public research bundle not received/admitted; no provisional briefs ingested.

rows.quantity: Native outputs, provenance and model-validity envelope
rows.first_model_role: mandatory for physically interpretable first cold-flow model; assumption only for an explicitly hypothetical model
rows.conditions_and_definition: Input hashes, solver/build/version, parameter/state/mesh IDs, convergence evidence, field associations and clear hypothetical/physical scope.
rows.required_evidence: Immutable native receipts and reproducible commands.
rows.gap: Existing native E/E-R1 outputs do not become 935 data.

rows.quantity: OpenUSD axes/units/time, composition and native-field mapping
rows.canonical_units: m; s; rad/s with explicit API conversion
rows.first_model_role: defer from isolated cold-flow model; needed at this later fidelity level
rows.conditions_and_definition: Asset identity, vehicle and fan frames, units, materials, animation/state and native node/cell/field links; generic validation separate from NVIDIA/physics validation.
rows.required_evidence: Resolved schema/runtime checks and native result association.
rows.gap: Horizontal 935 scene not validated; existing +Z composition is a different hypothesis.

rows.quantity: Physical twin state synchronization and validation
rows.first_model_role: defer from isolated cold-flow model; needed at this later fidelity level
rows.conditions_and_definition: Measured operating state and uncertainty, parameter identification, held-out correlation, version/configuration/time alignment and applicability envelope.
rows.required_evidence: Independent instrumented test data and accepted error criteria.
rows.gap: No validated horizontal 935 physical twin.

publication_scope: Original project matrix and method only; excludes restricted source content and raw scans
